title: Relational data modelling
brief: Design rows, keys and relationships that express the shop’s facts accurately. Diagnose dependencies and redundancy, distinguish historical facts from derived copies, and judge normalisation and modelling variations through required changes.

neighbouring_ownership.normalisation: Owns precise formal definitions, closure and decomposition methods.
neighbouring_ownership.hierarchies: Owns hierarchy representation comparisons and working maintenance procedures.
neighbouring_ownership.constraints: Owns enforcement, including subtype completeness and tenant references.
neighbouring_ownership.history: Owns temporal procedures; modelling establishes the difference between current and agreed price.
